newsitem.title: USA: Saks declines to make Barney's bid -for now.
newsitem.headline: Saks declines to make Barney's bid -for now.

text.p: Saks Holdings Inc said Monday it had decided against submitting a bid for Barney's Inc under previously announced terms, saying it could no longer justify a valuation of $290 million.
It said it may be very ineterested in acquiring the men's apparel retailer under different circumstances in the future, however.
Saks attributed its decision to Barney's recent announcement of a substantial write-off and the company's decision to close its landmark 17th Street store in New York City.
